```{r}
Trialless <- read_csv("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/R_outputs/Trialless.csv")
add_layers <- function(Data, depthpath) {
  list_of_depth <- list.files(
    path = depthpath,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  depth <- read_csv(list_of_depth, id = "id", col_names = F)
  depth <- depth %>%
    mutate(id = str_extract(depth$id, "M\\d+_\\d+")) %>%
    rename("surface" = X1)


  Layerd <- Data %>%
    separate_wider_delim(cluster_id2, delim = "_", names = c("del", "Mouse", "Day"), cols_remove = F) %>%
    unite("id", c(Mouse, Day)) %>%
    select(!del) %>%
    left_join(depth) %>%
    replace_na(list(surface = 950)) %>%
    mutate(dist_surf = surface - depth) %>%
    mutate(Layer_fine = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 50) ~ "L1",
      between(dist_surf, 50, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 750) ~ "L5A",
      between(dist_surf, 750, 1050) ~ "L5B",
      between(dist_surf, 1050, 1210) ~ "L6",
      .default = "WTF"
    )) %>%
    mutate(Layer = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 1210) ~ "L5",
      .default = "WTF"
    ))
  Layerd
}


metapath <- "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/meta"
list_of_meta <- list.files(
  path = metapath,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

meta <- read_tsv(list_of_meta, id = "id2") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(id2, cluster_id, n_spikes, depth, group, fr)
meta <- meta %>% mutate(id = str_extract(meta$id2, "M\\d+_\\d+"))

# Peak_to_trough times from python script
list_of_ptt <- list.files(
  path = "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/peak_to_trough_times",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
ptt <- read_csv(list_of_ptt, id = "id2") %>% as_tibble()

# keys to match the names of the Neruopixels data to the shortfrom M{id}_{session}
translator <- read_csv2("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/translator.csv")

PTT_data <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(meta %>% left_join(ptt %>% separate(Original_Index, into = c("old", "second_part"), sep = "(?=_row)", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(translator) %>% select(second_part:new) %>% select(!Folder) %>% separate_wider_delim(second_part, delim = "_", names = c("d1", "d2", "cluster_id")) %>% select(cluster_id:new) %>% rename(id = new) %>%
    mutate(cluster_id = as.numeric(cluster_id)) %>% filter(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` > 0.16)) %>%
    replace_na(list(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` = 0)) %>% mutate(newgroup = ifelse(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` == 0, group, "FS")) %>%
    filter(group != "noise")) %>%
  select(Behv:Zscore, newgroup, `Peak_to_Valley (ms)`) %>%
  filter(newgroup != "noise")

Trialless <- add_layers(PTT_data, "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/depths")
```

#multiple comparison correction

```{r}
zetapath <- "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/Zetatests"
list_of_zeta <- list.files(
  path = zetapath,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = T
)
zeta <- read_csv(list_of_zeta, id = "Behv")
# extract id from filename, remove videos with more than 2 missing frames
zeta <- zeta %>%
  mutate(Behv = str_extract(Behv, "(?<=/)[^/]+(?=\\.csv$)")) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv == "W2T", "HIT", Behv)) %>%
  unite("unit", c(unit, Mouse, Day)) %>%
  select(-`...1`)
zeta <- zeta %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")) %>%
  filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  select(Behv, unit, p_adj) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv %in% c("HIT", "Whisk"), "W2T", Behv)) %>%
  group_by(unit, Behv) %>%
  summarise(p_adj = min(p_adj)) %>%
  ungroup() # This last step is because there are 2 tests for Whisks and Hit but the plot shows them combined as W2T
```


# A prepare data


```{r}
pre <- Trialless %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -5, -2)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2, Behv) %>%
  summarise(pre = mean(Zscore))
post <- Trialless %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.1)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2, Behv) %>%
  summarise(post = mean(Zscore))

combcont2 <- pre %>%
  left_join(post) %>%
  left_join(Trialless %>% select(cluster_id2, Layer, newgroup) %>% distinct())

res2 <- combcont2 %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2, Behv) %>%
  summarise(
    diff = mean(post - pre, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(diff > 0, "increase", "decrease")
  ) %>%
  select(cluster_id2, Behv, direction) %>%
  left_join(zeta, by = join_by("cluster_id2" == "unit", Behv)) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = replace_na(p_adj, 1)) %>%
  mutate(dir_cat = ifelse(p_adj > 0.05, "no_change", direction)) %>%
  select(cluster_id2, Behv, dir_cat)


T3 <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(res2) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv == "PC", "UA", Behv))
baseline <- T3 %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -5, -2)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(Zs = mean(Zscore))
```



# A2L Plots
```{r}
n_cells <- T3 %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(newgroup != "mua") %>%
  filter(Layer %in% c("L2/3", "L5")) %>%
  mutate(newgroup = ifelse(newgroup == "good", "RS", newgroup)) %>%
  distinct(id, Layer, newgroup, dir_cat, cluster_id2) %>%
  group_by(newgroup, Layer, dir_cat) %>%
  summarise(n = n())


plotA2L_0.2 <- T3 %>%
  left_join(baseline) %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - Zs) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(newgroup != "mua") %>%
  filter(Layer %in% c("L2/3", "L5")) %>%
  mutate(newgroup = ifelse(newgroup == "good", "RS", newgroup)) %>%
  mutate(rel_time = floor(rel_time / 0.02) * 0.02) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2, Behv, newgroup, dir_cat, Layer, rel_time) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  group_by(Behv, newgroup, Layer, dir_cat, rel_time) %>%
  summarise(mean_Zscore = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore)) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -0.5, 0.5)) %>%
  left_join(n_cells) %>%
  mutate(sem = sd / sqrt(n))

plotA2L_0.2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, mean_Zscore)) +
  geom_line(aes(col = dir_cat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_Zscore - sem, ymax = mean_Zscore + sem, fill = dir_cat), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(newgroup ~ Layer) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3))

ggsave("F:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/moveDir_fig/A_A2L_line.svg")


n_cells %>%
  group_by(Layer, newgroup) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = prop, fill = dir_cat)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_grid(newgroup ~ Layer) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 1.6, label = n),
    color = "black",
    size = 5, position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, )
  )
ggsave("F:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/moveDir_fig/A_A2L_pie.svg")
```
